title: The Story
Of
Grasfam
aboutPage.desc: We are Grasfam, a travel service provider committed to providing the best travel experience at an affordable price. With an experienced team, we are ready to accompany your journey to your dream destination.
aboutPage.descStory: Founded in 2025, Grasfam was born from a passion for exploring the world and sharing unforgettable experiences with others. What started as a small group of travel enthusiasts has now grown into a trusted travel company, helping thousands of adventurers discover breathtaking destinations. In the early days, we focused on providing personalized travel experiences to a handful of destinations. Over time, our commitment to excellent service, transparency, and customer satisfaction allowed us to expand our offerings. Today, we provide a wide range of travel packages, from budget-friendly trips to luxury vacations, ensuring that every traveler finds the perfect journey.
aboutPage.descVision: At Grasfam, our vision is to become a leading travel provider that inspires and enables people to explore the world effortlessly. We aim to create seamless, personalized, and unforgettable travel experiences that connect cultures, foster adventure, and bring joy to every journey. By continuously evolving and adapting to the needs of modern travelers, we strive to make dream vacations a reality for everyone.

items.question: How to book a travel package?
items.answer: You can book a travel package directly on our website by selecting the destination, date, and number of participants, then follow the checkout process.

items.question: What payment methods are available?
items.answer: We accept payments via bank transfer, credit card, and e-wallets such as OVO, DANA, and GoPay.

items.question: How to use a discount voucher?
items.answer: Enter your voucher code at checkout in the 'Use Voucher' section before proceeding with payment.

items.question: How do I confirm my payment?
items.answer: After successful payment, you will receive a confirmation email. You can also check your booking status in your account dashboard.

items.question: What should I prepare before departure?
items.answer: Make sure to bring your official ID, booking confirmation, appropriate clothing, and any personal medications if needed.

items.question: What is the cancellation & refund policy?
items.answer: Cancellations can be made up to 7 days before departure. Refunds are subject to administrative fees according to our policy.

items.question: Can I change my travel date?
items.answer: Date changes can be requested at least 5 days before departure by contacting our customer support.

items.question: Is travel insurance included?
items.answer: Some packages include insurance. Details are available in the package description or by contacting our support team.

items.question: Who to contact in case of emergency during the trip?
items.answer: We provide a 24/7 emergency contact number included in your travel voucher.

items.question: What if I get separated from the group?
items.answer: Immediately contact our tour guide or emergency contact number. We will assist you in rejoining the group at the next meeting point.

items.question: Can I get help during the tour?
items.answer: Our guides and team are available to assist you with minor medical needs, local transport, and destination information during the tour.

questions.question: How to book a trip on Grasfam?
questions.answer: Choose your desired package from the pricing page and follow the checkout process.

questions.question: What payment methods are accepted?
questions.answer: We accept bank transfer, credit/debit cards, and selected e-wallets.

questions.question: Can I cancel a booking and get a refund?
questions.answer: Yes, please read our refund policy on the Terms & Conditions page.

questions.question: Do I get a voucher after my first booking?
questions.answer: Yes! First-time bookings are eligible for a $50 voucher or 50% discount on the next trip. Terms & conditions apply.
